# Synthetic Nastran HDF5 files

**Not real Nastran output.** Generated by `tools/make_synthetic_h5.py` from hand-calculation
formulas, for developing and testing the HDF5 reader until real MSC Nastran 2023.3 files are
available. The dataset layout imitates MSC Nastran's `.h5` output; names must be verified
against a real file. The root attribute `APB_SYNTHETIC = True` marks these files.

Units: `SI_mm` (mm, N, MPa, t).

| File | Model | Subcases | Results |
|------|-------|----------|---------|
| `synthetic_plate.h5` | Cantilever plate 500×200×2 mm, 40 CQUAD4 (101–140), CBEAM stiffener (201–210), 2 CONM2 (301–302) | 1 tip load Z, 2 pressure, 3 in-plane tip load Y; 10 modes 1–6 | displacement, SPC force, eigenvectors, eigenvalues, QUAD4 forces/stresses/strains, BEAM forces/stresses |
| `synthetic_fastener_joint.h5` | Lap joint, 6 fasteners: CBUSH 1001–1004, RBE2 2001–2002 | 1 shear X, 2 shear Y, 3 tension, 4 combined | CBUSH forces (element system, x = fastener axis), MPC forces and grid point forces for the RBE2s (basic system, Z = fastener axis) |

Regenerate: `python tools/make_synthetic_h5.py`
